seo.title: Case Study: HomeSilva — Real Estate Website | Máximo Silva
seo.description: How I digitized the property portfolio for HomeSilva, a real estate agency in Córdoba, with a catalog, search filters, maps, and a custom admin panel.

hero.title: HomeSilva — from paper listings to a
hero.subtitle: A real estate agency with over 15 years of experience in Córdoba, Argentina, that needed a modern online presence to showcase its properties and generate inquiries without depending on third-party portals.

desafio.title: The Challenge
desafio.texto: HomeSilva already had a solid portfolio and years of experience in the area, but its online presence didn't reflect that: it relied largely on external portals to showcase properties, with no space of its own where clients could search, filter, and get in touch directly. They needed a tool they could keep updated themselves, without depending on a developer for every change.

solucion.title: The Solution
solucion.texto: I designed and built a custom real estate platform with individual property pages, search filters, interactive maps, and direct contact forms. The centerpiece was the admin panel: the agency can add, edit, and remove properties on their own, without depending on me for every update.
incluye: Property catalog with individual listing pages and photo gallery
Search filters by location, type, and number of rooms
Admin panel for independent property management
Landing pages optimized for area-based searches

resultado.title: The Result
resultado.texto: HomeSilva now has its own platform to manage and showcase its property portfolio, improve the search experience for clients, and generate inquiries without relying solely on external portals. The platform remains active and growing, with continuous improvements and new features.
